name: One Last Turn
tagline: One private boundary. One remembered response. One last turn.

fontRationale.display: Fraunces — a variable 'old style' editorial display serif (soft + optical axes) built for literary/editorial mastheads; carries the restorative, human, letterpress feeling without reading as generic Georgia.
fontRationale.body: Public Sans — the humanist sans from the U.S. Web Design System, purpose-built for public-trust government interfaces; reads as calm, legible, institutional-trustworthy, which fits community-care.
fontRationale.mono: IBM Plex Mono — for provenance digests and receipts (git-hash / certificate-fingerprint idiom); signals 'verifiable evidence, private text withheld'.

signatureElement: Reserved clay reveal — clay (#a74f32) appears exactly once in a case's lifecycle, at the moment Mind B completes the remembered response (blockquote left-rule + the 'remembered' evidence badge + the A→B explainer's turn). The single moment that proves the product is the single moment the warm accent arrives.
references: U.S. Web Design System (Public Sans) — public-trust, high-legibility civic interfaces
Editorial serif+sans pairing (literary mastheads) — ruled-paper measure, generous leading
Provenance/receipt UIs (git commit hashes, Stripe receipts, certificate fingerprints) — monospace digest as trust signal
Restorative-justice / community-care print material — warm paper grounds, calm institutional tone, no alarm-red dashboards
